intro.title: Build mini virtual DOM diff and patch
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a mini virtual DOM diff and patch system from scratch using plain JavaScript. You'll learn how to represent HTML elements as lightweight JavaScript objects (virtual nodes), compare two virtual trees to find differences (diffing), and apply those changes to the real browser DOM (patching). The core programming concepts involve recursion for tree traversal, object comparison, and DOM manipulation. You'll work with key JavaScript constructs like objects, arrays, functions, and methods such as `document.createElement` and `appendChild`. By the end, you'll understand the fundamental logic behind how modern frameworks like React efficiently update the user interface.
intro.usecase: This virtual DOM diffing pattern is fundamental to modern JavaScript frameworks like React, Vue, and Svelte. You'll use it when building dynamic dashboards that update charts in real-time, interactive forms with live validation feedback, or e-commerce product filters that instantly refresh results. As a developer, implementing this pattern helps you optimize performance by minimizing expensive DOM manipulations—crucial for maintaining smooth user experiences in complex applications like social media feeds, collaborative editing tools, or data visualization platforms where UI updates happen frequently.
